units.source_text: 沿着河流行驶不多久，来到了辽阔的原野，山巅好像精工的雕刻，从那里浮现出一道柔和的斜线，一直延伸到山脚下。

en.t: After going along the river for a short while, we came out onto a broad plain; the mountain peak looked like a finely worked carving, and from it a gentle diagonal line appeared and stretched all the way down to the foot of the mountain.
The top of the mountain was bathed in moonlight.

units.source_text: 这是原野尽头唯一的景色。

en.t: It was the only sight at the far end of the plain.

units.source_text: 淡淡的晚霞把整个山容映成深宝蓝色，轮廓分明地浮现出来。

en.t: The faint evening glow colored the whole mountain a deep sapphire blue, bringing its outline sharply into view.

units.source_text: 月色虽已渐渐淡去，但余韵无穷，并不使人产生冬夜寒峭的感觉。

en.t: Although the moonlight was gradually fading, its lingering effect seemed endless and did not make one feel the sharp cold of a winter night.
Not a single bird was flying in the sky.

units.source_text: 山麓的原野，一望无垠，远远地向左右伸展，快到河边的地方，耸立着一座好像是水电站的白色建筑物。

en.t: The plain at the foot of the mountains stretched endlessly to the left and right, and near the river stood a white building that looked like a hydroelectric power station.

units.source_text: 那是透过车窗望见的、在一片冬日萧瑟的暮色中仅留下来的景物。

en.t: It was the only scene left in the bleak winter dusk, glimpsed through the train window.
